为什么会有白天黑夜与四季更迭？: Why do we have day, night and seasons?
地球自转让大多数地点交替进入日侧和夜侧。地轴倾角约 23.44°，在一年中基本保: Earth's spin carries most locations between day and night. Its axis is tilted about 23.44° and keeps nearly the same direction over a year. As Earth orbits, the hemispheres take turns tilting sunward, changing solar altitude and day length: the main cause of seasons.
日地距离也会影响辐照度，但不能解释南北半球相反的季节。气温还受海洋、大气与地形影: Earth–Sun distance also affects irradiance, but cannot explain opposite seasons in the two hemispheres. Oceans, atmosphere and terrain also affect temperature; the solstice is not necessarily the hottest day.
采用圆轨道、固定地轴、球形地球与平行光。公转画面放大了地球，大小与轨道距离不按同: A circular orbit, fixed axis, spherical Earth and parallel light. Earth is enlarged in the orbit view, so body size and orbital distance use different scales. The seasons view shows only eight spins per orbit for clarity. The timeline is simulation progress, not a real date or local clock time.
城市卡片的此刻太阳高度与昼夜贴图使用同一太阳方向。白昼时长是点太阳几何值，不含折: City solar-altitude readings and day/night textures use the same Sun direction. Day length uses point-Sun geometry without refraction, terrain or apparent solar radius. The special case of a polar Sun on the ideal horizon at an equinox is labeled separately.
“假如地轴不倾斜”保留公转，将倾角设为零，用于比较倾角造成的日照变化。“光照角度: “What if there were no tilt?” keeps the orbit and sets tilt to zero to compare tilt-driven sunlight changes. “Direct & slanted light” compares geometric projection only, not weather or temperature.
